annotations.title: XML Sitemap & Index Crawler Tree Decompiler

description: Parses XML sitemaps and sitemap index files into structured URL trees with change frequency and last-modified filters. Use when discovering domain architectures, mapping crawl frontiers, or indexing blog/product catalogues; for extracting on-page hyperlinks from raw HTML, use extract_page_hyperlinks instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sitemap_xml' ('filter_criteria' defaults to 'all_entries'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

filter_criteria.description: URL retention filter: all entries, recently modified lastmod only, or HTML pages only.

max_results.description: Maximum number of URLs to extract and return in the catalog.

sitemap_xml.description: XML string of the sitemap or sitemapindex file to inspect and parse.

name: crawl_sitemap_urls

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for crawl_sitemap_urls.

sitemap_entries.description: List of structured URL entries containing loc, lastmod, and priority.

sub_sitemaps.description: Nested child sitemap URLs detected if document is a sitemapindex file.

total_urls_found.description: Total valid loc URLs parsed from the XML sitemap document.

title: XML Sitemap & Index Crawler Tree Decompiler
